-- ScriptVerse Solara compat (auto)
do
	local g = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
	local C = rawget(g, "SVCompat")
	if type(C) ~= "table" or not C.__svcompat then
		local function executorName()
			local ok, n = pcall(function()
				return (identifyexecutor and identifyexecutor()) or (getexecutorname and getexecutorname()) or ""
			end)
			return (ok and tostring(n) or ""):lower()
		end
		local exec = executorName()
		local isSolara = exec:find("solara", 1, true) ~= nil
			or exec:find("xeno", 1, true) ~= nil
			or exec:find("micro", 1, true) ~= nil
		local realRequire = require
		C = {
			__svcompat = true,
			Executor = exec,
			IsSolara = isSolara,
			AllowRequire = true,
			AllowHooks = (not isSolara) and typeof(hookmetamethod) == "function",
			AllowGc = typeof(getgc) == "function",
			AllowDrawing = typeof(Drawing) == "table" and typeof(Drawing.new) == "function",
			rawRequire = realRequire,
		}
		function C.softRequire(mod)
			if mod == nil then return nil end
			-- Always try real require first (Flamework hubs need it).
			-- Only learn Solara-broken after the engine errors.
			local ok, res = pcall(realRequire, mod)
			if ok then return res end
			local err = string.lower(tostring(res))
			if err:find("cannot require", 1, true)
				or err:find("cast string to bool", 1, true)
				or err:find("unable to cast", 1, true)
			then
				C.IsSolara = true
				C.AllowRequire = false
			end
			return nil
		end
		C.require = C.softRequire
		C.rawRequire = realRequire
		function C.child(parent, ...)
			local cur = parent
			for i = 1, select("#", ...) do
				if typeof(cur) ~= "Instance" then return nil end
				cur = cur:FindFirstChild((select(i, ...)))
			end
			return cur
		end
		function C.softDrawing(class)
			if not C.AllowDrawing then return nil end
			local ok, obj = pcall(Drawing.new, class)
			return ok and obj or nil
		end
		function C.canHook() return C.AllowHooks == true end
		function C.canGc() return C.AllowGc == true end
		g.SVCompat = C
	end
end
local require = (function()
	local g = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
	local C = rawget(g, "SVCompat")
	if type(C) == "table" and type(C.require) == "function" then
		return C.require
	end
	return require
end)()

--[[
  ScriptVerse — Steal a Egg Pet Spawner
  PlaceId: 107778070777162

  Standalone pet spawner — visual pets on your plot with mutations, size & income FX.
]]

local PLACE_ID = 107778070777162
local genv = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G

if type(genv.SV_SAE_SHUTDOWN) == "function" then
	pcall(genv.SV_SAE_SHUTDOWN)
	task.wait(0.1)
end
if type(genv.SV_SAE_PET_SPAWNER_SHUTDOWN) == "function" then
	pcall(genv.SV_SAE_PET_SPAWNER_SHUTDOWN)
	task.wait(0.1)
end

if genv.SV_SAE_PET_SPAWNER_RUNNING then
	return
end
genv.SV_SAE_PET_SPAWNER_RUNNING = true

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer or Players.PlayerAdded:Wait()

local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local acConns = {}
local REPORT_KEY = "RuntimeSync: Status"
local VIOL_KEY = "ClientCharacter: IntegrityViolation"

local COREGUI_HIDE = {
	"dex", "dex explorer", "remote spy", "hydroxide", "dark dex", "simple spy",
	"owl hub", "rayfield", "infinite yield", "potassium", "scriptware", "fluxus",
}

local function nameLooksLikeExploitUi(name)
	local n = string.lower(tostring(name or ""))
	for _, bad in ipairs(COREGUI_HIDE) do
		if n:find(bad, 1, true) then return true end
	end
	return false
end

local function filterCoreGuiChildren(list)
	if type(list) ~= "table" then return list end
	local out = {}
	for _, inst in ipairs(list) do
		if not nameLooksLikeExploitUi(inst.Name) then out[#out + 1] = inst end
	end
	return out
end

local function isAcRemoteName(name)
	if type(name) ~= "string" then return false end
	if name == REPORT_KEY or name == VIOL_KEY then return true end
	if name:find("IntegrityViolation", 1, true) then return true end
	if name:find("RuntimeSync", 1, true) and name:find("Status", 1, true) then return true end
	return false
end

local function blankRemoteFireServer(remote)
	local blanked = genv.SV_SAE_BLANKED_REMOTES
	if not remote or (blanked and blanked[remote]) then return end
	if not (remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") or remote:IsA("UnreliableRemoteEvent")) then return end
	if type(hookfunction) ~= "function" then return end
	genv.SV_SAE_BLANKED_REMOTES = genv.SV_SAE_BLANKED_REMOTES or {}
	genv.SV_SAE_BLANKED_REMOTES[remote] = remote.FireServer
	hookfunction(remote.FireServer, function() return nil end)
end

local function severBindableTx(key)
	local netMod = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Library")
		and ReplicatedStorage.Library:FindFirstChild("Client")
		and ReplicatedStorage.Library.Client:FindFirstChild("Network")
	if not netMod or type(getconnections) ~= "function" then return end
	for _, d in ipairs(netMod:GetDescendants()) do
		if d.Name == key and d:IsA("BindableEvent") then
			for _, cn in ipairs(getconnections(d.Event)) do pcall(function() cn:Disable() end) end
		end
	end
end

local function shieldNetFolder(folder)
	for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if isAcRemoteName(child.Name) then blankRemoteFireServer(child) end
	end
	acConns[#acConns + 1] = folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if isAcRemoteName(child.Name) then task.defer(blankRemoteFireServer, child) end
	end)
end

local function pinUiToPlayerGui()
	local pg = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	if type(gethui) == "function" and not genv.SV_SAE_OLD_GETHUI then
		genv.SV_SAE_OLD_GETHUI = gethui
		gethui = function() return pg end
	end
	return pg
end

local function installAcBypass()
	if genv.SV_SAE_AC_BYPASS then return true end
	genv.SV_SAE_BLANKED_REMOTES = genv.SV_SAE_BLANKED_REMOTES or {}
	pcall(function()
		local Network = require(ReplicatedStorage.Library.Client.Network)
		local NET = Network.NET_MAP or {}
		if NET.RuntimeSync and NET.RuntimeSync.REPORT then REPORT_KEY = NET.RuntimeSync.REPORT end
		if NET.ClientCharacter and NET.ClientCharacter.INTEGRITY_VIOLATION then
			VIOL_KEY = NET.ClientCharacter.INTEGRITY_VIOLATION
		end
	end)
	local netFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Network", 20)
	if netFolder then shieldNetFolder(netFolder) end
	severBindableTx(REPORT_KEY)
	severBindableTx(VIOL_KEY)
	if type(hookfunction) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			local old = CoreGui.GetChildren
			genv.SV_SAE_OLD_GETCHILDREN = old
			hookfunction(old, function(self, ...)
				local list = old(self, ...)
				return self == CoreGui and filterCoreGuiChildren(list) or list
			end)
		end)
	end
	if type(hookmetamethod) == "function" and type(getnamecallmethod) == "function" then
		local wrap = newcclosure or function(f) return f end
		local oldNc
		oldNc = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", wrap(function(self, ...)
			if getnamecallmethod() == "FireServer" and typeof(self) == "Instance" and isAcRemoteName(self.Name) then
				return nil
			end
			return oldNc(self, ...)
		end))
		genv.SV_SAE_OLD_NAMECALL = oldNc
	end
	genv.SV_SAE_AC_BYPASS = true
	genv.SV_SAE_AC_CONNS = acConns
	return true
end

installAcBypass()
pinUiToPlayerGui()

local SVUI = genv.SVUI or _G.SVUI
if not SVUI then
	pinUiToPlayerGui()
	local ok, lib = pcall(function()
		return loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://scriptversekey.xyz/svui.lua"))()
	end)
	if ok then
		SVUI = lib
	end
end
if not SVUI then
	warn("[ScriptVerse] SVUI failed to load")
	genv.SV_SAE_PET_SPAWNER_RUNNING = nil
	return
end

local function softRequire(inst)
	if typeof(inst) ~= "Instance" then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, mod = pcall(require, inst)
	return ok and mod or nil
end

local function listHas(list, value)
	for _, v in ipairs(list) do
		if v == value then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local Accent = Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 160)
local OkGreen = Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 140)
local WarnOrange = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 80)

local function notify(title, content, color, dur)
	pcall(function()
		SVUI:Notify({
			Title = title,
			Content = content,
			Duration = dur or 2.2,
			Color = color or Accent,
		})
	end)
end

local Lib = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Library", 30)
local Client = Lib:WaitForChild("Client", 15)
local Util = Lib:WaitForChild("Util", 15)

local PlotCmds = softRequire(Client:WaitForChild("PlotCmds", 15))
local Save = softRequire(Client:WaitForChild("Save", 15))
local AssetCmds = softRequire(Client:WaitForChild("AssetCmds", 15))
local AssetGenerationUtil = softRequire(Util:WaitForChild("AssetGenerationUtil", 15))
local AssetModelStreaming = softRequire(Client:WaitForChild("AssetModelStreaming", 15))

if not PlotCmds or not AssetCmds then
	notify("Steal a Egg Pet Spawner", "Game modules blocked on this executor", WarnOrange, 4)
	genv.SV_SAE_PET_SPAWNER_RUNNING = nil
	return
end

local State = {
	running = true,
	antiAfk = false,
	lastAfk = 0,
	visualPet = "Bananita Dolphinita",
	visualMutation = "Golden",
	visualScale = 2.5,
	petSortMode = "Most Valuable",
	petSearchQuery = "",
}

local conns = {}
local assetCategories = {}
local petCatalog = {}
local basePetCatalog = {}
local rateCache = {}
local rateCacheKey = ""
local cachedSaveContext = nil
local cachedSaveAt = 0
local petDropdown = nil
local searchInput = nil
local ActiveAssetsController = nil
local ActiveAssetIncomePopup = nil
local pushQueued = false
local Visual = {
	pets = {},
	pushing = false,
}
local lastRepushAt = 0
local repushCount = 0
local MAX_REPUSH = 6
local REPUSH_COOLDOWN = 5

local function track(conn)
	table.insert(conns, conn)
	return conn
end

local function disconnectAll()
	for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
		pcall(function()
			c:Disconnect()
		end)
	end
	table.clear(conns)
end

local function loadAssetsDirectory()
	local dir = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Directory")
	local assetsMod = dir and dir:FindFirstChild("Assets")
	if not assetsMod then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, Assets = pcall(require, assetsMod)
	if ok and type(Assets.Directory) == "table" then
		return Assets.Directory
	end
	return nil
end

local function buildVisualItemData(category, mutation, scale)
	local item = {
		Category = category,
		Scale = math.clamp(scale, 0.15, 8),
		Mutations = {},
		ColorIndex = math.random(0, 4),
		ColorSeed = math.random(1, 2147483646),
		EyeColor = string.format("%06x", math.random(0, 16777215)),
		Gender = math.random() > 0.5 and "Male" or "Female",
		Personality = "Energetic",
		HasBeenFirstPlaced = true,
		InFuse = false,
	}
	if mutation and mutation ~= "None" then
		item.BaseMutation = mutation
		item.Mutations = { mutation }
	end
	return item
end

local function getSaveContext()
	if cachedSaveContext and os.clock() - cachedSaveAt < 3 then
		return cachedSaveContext
	end
	local s = nil
	if Save and type(Save.Get) == "function" then
		local ok, data = pcall(Save.Get, LocalPlayer, false)
		if ok then
			s = data
		end
	end
	cachedSaveContext = {
		rebirth = (s and s.Rebirth) or 0,
		gamepasses = (s and s.Gamepasses) or {},
		products = (s and s.Products) or {},
	}
	cachedSaveAt = os.clock()
	return cachedSaveContext
end

local function sampleItemForRate(category, mutation, scale)
	local item = {
		Category = category,
		Scale = math.clamp(scale, 0.15, 8),
		Mutations = {},
		ColorIndex = 0,
		ColorSeed = 1,
		EyeColor = "ffffff",
		Gender = "Male",
		Personality = "Energetic",
		HasBeenFirstPlaced = true,
		InFuse = false,
	}
	if mutation and mutation ~= "None" then
		item.BaseMutation = mutation
		item.Mutations = { mutation }
	end
	return item
end

local function visualMoneyRate(itemData)
	if not AssetGenerationUtil or type(AssetGenerationUtil.GetRate) ~= "function" then
		return 100
	end
	local ctx = getSaveContext()
	local ok, rate = pcall(AssetGenerationUtil.GetRate, itemData, ctx.rebirth, ctx.gamepasses, ctx.products)
	return ok and rate or 100
end

local function buildBasePetCatalog()
	if #basePetCatalog > 0 then
		return basePetCatalog
	end
	local seen = {}
	local directory = loadAssetsDirectory()
	if directory then
		for name, entry in pairs(directory) do
			seen[name] = true
			local rarity = 0
			if type(entry.Rarity) == "table" and type(entry.Rarity.RarityNumber) == "number" then
				rarity = entry.Rarity.RarityNumber
			end
			basePetCatalog[#basePetCatalog + 1] = {
				name = name,
				rarity = rarity,
			}
		end
	end
	local folder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("AssetModels")
	if folder then
		for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
			if not seen[child.Name] then
				basePetCatalog[#basePetCatalog + 1] = {
					name = child.Name,
					rarity = 0,
				}
			end
		end
	end
	return basePetCatalog
end

local function rebuildRateCache()
	local key = State.visualMutation .. ":" .. tostring(State.visualScale)
	if key == rateCacheKey then
		return
	end
	rateCacheKey = key
	table.clear(rateCache)
	local mutation = State.visualMutation
	local scale = State.visualScale
	for _, entry in ipairs(buildBasePetCatalog()) do
		rateCache[entry.name] = visualMoneyRate(sampleItemForRate(entry.name, mutation, scale))
	end
end

local function rebuildPetCatalogView()
	rebuildRateCache()
	table.clear(petCatalog)
	for _, entry in ipairs(buildBasePetCatalog()) do
		petCatalog[#petCatalog + 1] = {
			name = entry.name,
			rarity = entry.rarity,
			rate = rateCache[entry.name] or 0,
		}
	end
end

local function sortPetCatalog(list, mode)
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		if mode == "Most Valuable" then
			if a.rate ~= b.rate then
				return a.rate > b.rate
			end
		elseif mode == "Rarest" then
			if a.rarity ~= b.rarity then
				return a.rarity > b.rarity
			end
		end
		return a.name < b.name
	end)
	return list
end

local function filteredPetNames()
	local query = string.lower(State.petSearchQuery or "")
	local filtered = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(petCatalog) do
		if query == "" or string.find(string.lower(entry.name), query, 1, true) then
			filtered[#filtered + 1] = entry
		end
	end
	sortPetCatalog(filtered, State.petSortMode)
	local names = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(filtered) do
		names[#names + 1] = entry.name
	end
	return names
end

local function refreshPetDropdown(keepSelection, rebuildRates)
	if rebuildRates ~= false or #petCatalog == 0 then
		rebuildPetCatalogView()
	end
	assetCategories = filteredPetNames()
	if not listHas(assetCategories, State.visualPet) then
		State.visualPet = assetCategories[1] or State.visualPet
	end
	if petDropdown and petDropdown.Refresh then
		petDropdown:Refresh(assetCategories, keepSelection ~= false)
	end
	return assetCategories
end

local rateRefreshToken = 0
local function scheduleRateRefresh()
	rateRefreshToken += 1
	local token = rateRefreshToken
	task.delay(0.35, function()
		if token == rateRefreshToken and State.running then
			refreshPetDropdown(true)
		end
	end)
end

local function refreshAssetList()
	return refreshPetDropdown(true)
end

local function cloneItemData(item)
	local out = table.clone(item)
	if type(item.Mutations) == "table" then
		out.Mutations = table.clone(item.Mutations)
	end
	return out
end

local function makeVisualUid()
	return string.gsub(HttpService:GenerateGUID(false), "-", "")
end

local function resolveCategory(name)
	if not name or name == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local exact = tostring(name)
	if listHas(assetCategories, exact) then
		return exact
	end
	local lower = string.lower(exact)
	for _, cat in ipairs(assetCategories) do
		if string.lower(cat) == lower then
			return cat
		end
	end
	for _, cat in ipairs(assetCategories) do
		if string.find(string.lower(cat), lower, 1, true) then
			return cat
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function buildRuntimeRecord(uid, itemData, firstPlacement)
	return {
		OwnerUserId = LocalPlayer.UserId,
		UID = uid,
		ItemData = cloneItemData(itemData),
		MoneyPerSecond = visualMoneyRate(itemData),
		Seed = math.random(1, 999999),
		IsFirstPlacement = firstPlacement == true,
	}
end

local function canPushRuntime()
	return AssetCmds
		and AssetCmds.RuntimeOwnerUpdated
		and type(AssetCmds.RuntimeOwnerUpdated.Fire) == "function"
end

local function pushVisualRuntime()
	if not canPushRuntime() then
		return false
	end
	if not PlotCmds.GetPlotData() then
		return false
	end
	local merged = {}
	for uid, rec in pairs(AssetCmds.GetOwnerRuntimeRecords(LocalPlayer.UserId) or {}) do
		if not Visual.pets[uid] then
			merged[uid] = rec
		end
	end
	for uid, entry in pairs(Visual.pets) do
		merged[uid] = entry.record
	end
	Visual.pushing = true
	local ok = pcall(function()
		AssetCmds.RuntimeOwnerUpdated:Fire(LocalPlayer.UserId, merged)
	end)
	Visual.pushing = false
	return ok
end

local function schedulePushVisualRuntime()
	if pushQueued or Visual.pushing then
		return
	end
	pushQueued = true
	task.defer(function()
		pushQueued = false
		pushVisualRuntime()
	end)
end

local function spawnVisualPet(category, mutation, scale)
	category = resolveCategory(category or State.visualPet)
	mutation = mutation or State.visualMutation
	scale = scale or State.visualScale

	if not category then
		notify("Pet Spawner", "Pick a valid pet from the list", WarnOrange)
		return nil
	end

	State.visualPet = category

	if AssetModelStreaming and type(AssetModelStreaming.ForceLoadAssetModels) == "function" then
		pcall(AssetModelStreaming.ForceLoadAssetModels, { category })
	end

	local itemData = buildVisualItemData(category, mutation, scale)
	local uid = makeVisualUid()
	Visual.pets[uid] = {
		itemData = itemData,
		record = buildRuntimeRecord(uid, itemData, true),
	}

	if not pushVisualRuntime() then
		Visual.pets[uid] = nil
		notify("Pet Spawner", "Could not render — stand on your plot and retry", WarnOrange, 3)
		return nil
	end

	repushCount = 0

	task.delay(2, function()
		local entry = Visual.pets[uid]
		if entry and entry.record then
			entry.record.IsFirstPlacement = false
		end
	end)

	return uid
end

local function clearVisualPets()
	table.clear(Visual.pets)
	repushCount = 0
	pushVisualRuntime()
end

local function maybeRepushVisualRuntime()
	if repushCount >= MAX_REPUSH then
		return
	end
	if os.clock() - lastRepushAt < REPUSH_COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastRepushAt = os.clock()
	repushCount += 1
	schedulePushVisualRuntime()
end

local function initMoneyModules()
	if ActiveAssetIncomePopup and ActiveAssetsController then
		return true
	end
	local playerScripts = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
	if not playerScripts then
		return false
	end
	local popupMod = playerScripts:FindFirstChild("GUI")
	popupMod = popupMod and popupMod:FindFirstChild("ActiveAssetIncomePopup")
	if popupMod then
		ActiveAssetIncomePopup = softRequire(popupMod)
	end
	local plots = playerScripts:FindFirstChild("Game")
	plots = plots and plots:FindFirstChild("Plots")
	local aacMod = plots and plots:FindFirstChild("ActiveAssetsController")
	if aacMod then
		ActiveAssetsController = softRequire(aacMod)
	end
	return ActiveAssetIncomePopup
		and ActiveAssetsController
		and type(ActiveAssetIncomePopup.Show) == "function"
		and type(ActiveAssetsController.GetModelByUID) == "function"
end

local function showVisualIncomePopups()
	if not next(Visual.pets) then
		return
	end
	if not initMoneyModules() then
		return
	end
	for uid, entry in pairs(Visual.pets) do
		local model = ActiveAssetsController.GetModelByUID(uid)
		local amount = entry.record and entry.record.MoneyPerSecond
		if model and type(amount) == "number" and amount > 0 then
			pcall(ActiveAssetIncomePopup.Show, model, amount, {
				alwaysOnTop = true,
			})
		end
	end
end

local function visualRecordsMissing(records)
	if type(records) ~= "table" then
		return true
	end
	for uid in pairs(Visual.pets) do
		if records[uid] == nil then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

if AssetCmds.RuntimeOwnerUpdated then
	track(AssetCmds.RuntimeOwnerUpdated:Connect(function(userId, records)
		if userId ~= LocalPlayer.UserId or not next(Visual.pets) or Visual.pushing then
			return
		end
		if visualRecordsMissing(records) then
			maybeRepushVisualRuntime()
		end
	end))
end
if AssetCmds.RuntimeSnapshotUpdated then
	track(AssetCmds.RuntimeSnapshotUpdated:Connect(function()
		if not next(Visual.pets) or Visual.pushing then
			return
		end
		if visualRecordsMissing(AssetCmds.GetOwnerRuntimeRecords(LocalPlayer.UserId)) then
			maybeRepushVisualRuntime()
		end
	end))
end

for _ = 1, 40 do
	refreshAssetList()
	if #assetCategories > 0 then
		break
	end
	task.wait(0.25)
end

if not listHas(assetCategories, State.visualPet) then
	State.visualPet = assetCategories[1] or "Turtle"
end

local Window = SVUI:CreateWindow({
	Title = "Steal a Egg Pet Spawner",
	SubTitle = "ScriptVerse",
})

pcall(function()
	local pg = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
	if not pg then
		return
	end
	for _, gui in ipairs(game:GetService("CoreGui"):GetChildren()) do
		if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") and string.sub(gui.Name, 1, 4) == "SVUI" then
			gui.Parent = pg
		end
	end
end)

local PetSpawnerTab = Window:CreateTab({ Title = "Pet Spawner" })
local Misc = Window:CreateTab({ Title = "Misc" })

PetSpawnerTab:CreateSection("Spawn")

searchInput = PetSpawnerTab:CreateInput({
	Title = "Search",
	Default = "",
	Placeholder = "Filter pets...",
	Callback = function(v)
		State.petSearchQuery = v or ""
		refreshPetDropdown(true, false)
	end,
})

PetSpawnerTab:CreateDropdown({
	Title = "Sort",
	Options = { "Most Valuable", "Rarest", "A-Z" },
	Default = State.petSortMode,
	Callback = function(v)
		State.petSortMode = v
		refreshPetDropdown(true, false)
	end,
})

if #assetCategories > 0 then
	petDropdown = PetSpawnerTab:CreateDropdown({
		Title = "Pet",
		Options = assetCategories,
		Default = State.visualPet,
		Callback = function(v)
			State.visualPet = v
		end,
	})
end

PetSpawnerTab:CreateDropdown({
	Title = "Mutation",
	Options = { "None", "Silver", "Golden", "Rainbow" },
	Default = State.visualMutation,
	Callback = function(v)
		State.visualMutation = v
		scheduleRateRefresh()
	end,
})

PetSpawnerTab:CreateSlider({
	Title = "Pet Size (Kg)",
	Min = 0.2,
	Max = 6,
	Default = State.visualScale,
	Callback = function(v)
		State.visualScale = v
		scheduleRateRefresh()
	end,
})

PetSpawnerTab:CreateButton({
	Title = "Spawn Pet On Plot",
	Callback = function()
		task.spawn(function()
			if spawnVisualPet() then
				notify("Pet Spawner", State.visualPet .. " spawned on plot", OkGreen)
			end
		end)
	end,
})

PetSpawnerTab:CreateButton({
	Title = "Clear Spawned Pets",
	Callback = function()
		clearVisualPets()
		notify("Pet Spawner", "Cleared spawned pets", Accent)
	end,
})

Misc:CreateToggle({
	Title = "Anti AFK",
	Default = false,
	Callback = function(v)
		State.antiAfk = v
	end,
})

Misc:CreateButton({
	Title = "Rejoin",
	Callback = function()
		TeleportService:Teleport(PLACE_ID, LocalPlayer)
	end,
})

Misc:CreateButton({
	Title = "Panic Unload",
	Callback = function()
		pcall(genv.SV_SAE_PET_SPAWNER_SHUTDOWN)
	end,
})

notify("Steal a Egg Pet Spawner", #assetCategories .. " pets ready", OkGreen)

task.spawn(function()
	while State.running do
		if #assetCategories == 0 then
			refreshAssetList()
			if #assetCategories > 0 and petDropdown and petDropdown.Refresh then
				petDropdown:Refresh(assetCategories, true)
			end
		end
		if next(Visual.pets) then
			showVisualIncomePopups()
		end
		if State.antiAfk and os.clock() - State.lastAfk > 480 then
			State.lastAfk = os.clock()
			pcall(function()
				local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
				if cam then
					cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(0.001), 0)
				end
			end)
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end)

genv.SV_SAE_PET_SPAWNER_SHUTDOWN = function()
	State.running = false
	disconnectAll()
	clearVisualPets()
	genv.SV_SAE_AC_BYPASS = nil
	genv.SV_SAE_OLD_NAMECALL = nil
	genv.SV_SAE_OLD_FIRESERVER = nil
	genv.SV_SAE_PET_SPAWNER_RUNNING = nil
	genv.SV_SAE_PET_SPAWNER_SHUTDOWN = nil
	pcall(function()
		Window:Destroy()
	end)
end

genv.SV_SAE_PET_SPAWNER = {
	spawn = spawnVisualPet,
	clear = clearVisualPets,
	refresh = refreshAssetList,
	State = State,
}
